author: Zephyr II
title: Adaptive Station Pilot - v4 Prioritization Snapshot (Onboarding Workflow)
abstract: Runs AdaptiveStation.prioritize on seeded onboarding events using v4 sampler; outputs json snapshot for comparison to v0 baseline.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from utilities.adaptive_station import AdaptiveStation

agents = ['Axiom I', 'Explorer I', 'Logos I', 'Nexus I', 'Zephyr II']
station = AdaptiveStation()
priorities = station.prioritize(agents)

out_path = Path("storage/shared/meta/priorities/AS_onboarding_pilot_v4_tick64.json")
out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(priorities, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print("v4 prioritization snapshot complete:", priorities)
